title: The held-out cases with a structured output

changed: A NetBox job answers through Goose's structured output since `ac29afb`, and the job program writes the verification gate's lines from it. The seed holds the fix of targets #15, so the cases' expected verdicts changed at `dd75b6a`, and no case has a fix to propose.
